notes: 📡 The radar now collapses whenever signals simply aren't ready — regardless of why. Previously it only collapsed while preparation was actively running, so a tab whose load was stuck (0 shares ready, prep never started) still sprawled the empty half-screen grid. Now: not ready = collapsed to the market row and one honest line, unfolding at ~30% prepared. Also in this build's era: if an old saved list keeps saying “N still need data”, press the green Refresh / redownload — it replaces the stale list with the clean ~2,215 investables.
